name: 086.2 — what you registered, you can list

description: Self-checking suite for task 086.2: hafen.slash() is a collection of this addon's own command Subs — :count, the array :list, :get(name) by identity, :find by the string filter and a miss that answers nil — while hafen.event():list/:count answer over the hub's three emitters, both counts fall back on sub:off(), and the arity refusal survived the mount.
